name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1935: The second vault writer, which v1934 named as having no frame in scope and therefore unfixable, had better provenance all along. Its enclosing function holds fname, the uploaded screenshot filename, and the vault has been stashing the FULL RES image in IndexedDB under that same key since v365 for click to enlarge - so this lane can not only name its source, it can show it. The receipt existed, was already keyed, and the row dropped it. The keeper card now distinguishes three states: read from a reel and named by frame, read from an upload and named by a filename whose full res shot is stored and openable, and predating provenance where it says so and tells him to untick it if he does not own it. Collapsing any two of those is how a claim outlives its evidence. The lesson is about the earlier finding rather than this fix: the claim that no frame was in scope came from a regex that walked up a few lines and hit a helper by coincidence, while walking out by brace depth found the real enclosing function immediately. A negative claim deserves the same measurement as a positive one, and I published unfixable on the worse instrument.
